```{r}
filtered = data |> select(
  -SEX,
  -ALC_freq_3
)
glimpse(filtered)

levels(filtered$SEX_factor)
```



```{r}
# CKD: 1 = has CKD, 0 = does not
# Testing for alcohol types
alc_type_fit <- gam(
  CKD ~ SEX_factor + AGE +
    s(alcohol_quantity, by = SEX_factor, k = 5) +
    Low_alcohol_beer + Mid_strength_beer + Full_strength_beer +
    White_wine + Red_wine + Low_alcohol_wine +
    Champagne_sparkling_wine + Spirits_RTD + Liqueurs +
    Spirits + Fortified_wine + Cider + Cocktails,
  data = filtered,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "REML"
)
summary(alc_type_fit)
```


```{r}
# Exact observations used in the age-adjusted GAM
d <- model.frame(alc_type_fit)

drink_types <- c(
  "Low_alcohol_beer", "Mid_strength_beer", "Full_strength_beer",
  "White_wine", "Red_wine", "Low_alcohol_wine",
  "Champagne_sparkling_wine", "Spirits_RTD", "Liqueurs",
  "Spirits", "Fortified_wine", "Cider", "Cocktails"
)

f <- reformulate(
  c("AGE", "alcohol_quantity * SEX_factor", drink_types),
  response = "CKD"
)

m_int <- glm(f, data = d, family = binomial())

m_common <- update(
  m_int,
  . ~ . - alcohol_quantity:SEX_factor
)

# Direct test: do quantity slopes differ by sex?
anova(m_common, m_int, test = "Chisq")
```


```{r}
slopes <- emtrends(
  m_int,
  ~ SEX_factor,
  var = "alcohol_quantity",
  nuisance = c("AGE", drink_types)
)

# Sex-specific odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals
results <- as.data.frame(confint(slopes))

data.frame(
  Sex = results$SEX_factor,
  OR = exp(results$alcohol_quantity.trend),
  Lower_95 = exp(results$asymp.LCL),
  Upper_95 = exp(results$asymp.UCL)
)

# Direct comparison of quantity slopes between sexes
pairs(slopes)
```


```{r}
# 7day is determined by alc quantity
ggplot(
  filtered,
  aes(
    x = Alcohol_risk_7day,
    y = alcohol_quantity,
    colour = CKD
  )
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.2,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("0" = "#0072B2", "1" = "#D55E00"),
    breaks = c("0", "1"),
    labels = c("No CKD", "CKD")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Alcohol risk category",
    y = "Alcohol quantity",
    colour = "CKD status"
  ) + 
  facet_wrap(~ SEX_factor) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Testing for alcohol risk(s)
risk_fit <- gam(
  CKD ~ SEX_factor + AGE + Alcohol_risk_7day + Alcohol_risk +
    s(alcohol_quantity, by = SEX_factor, k = 5),
  data = filtered,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "REML"
)
summary(risk_fit)
```

```{r}
d <- filtered %>%
  mutate(CKD_num = as.integer(as.character(CKD))) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(CKD_num),
    !is.na(SEX_factor),
    is.finite(alcohol_quantity)
  )

# Common quantity groups across sexes
cuts <- unique(quantile(
  d$alcohol_quantity,
  probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 9)
))

binned <- d %>%
  mutate(quantity_bin = cut(
    alcohol_quantity, breaks = cuts, include.lowest = TRUE
  )) %>%
  group_by(SEX_factor, quantity_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    quantity = mean(alcohol_quantity),
    n = n(),
    cases = sum(CKD_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prevalence = cases / n,
    denominator = 1 + 1.96^2 / n,
    centre = (prevalence + 1.96^2 / (2 * n)) / denominator,
    margin = 1.96 * sqrt(
      prevalence * (1 - prevalence) / n + 1.96^2 / (4 * n^2)
    ) / denominator,
    lower = centre - margin,
    upper = centre + margin
  )

ggplot(binned, aes(quantity, prevalence)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~ SEX_factor) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    x = "Alcohol quantity",
    y = "Observed CKD prevalence",
    size = "Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(d, aes(alcohol_quantity, CKD_num)) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(colour = "Logistic"),
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = binomial()),
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(colour = "GAM"),
    method = "gam",
    method.args = list(family = binomial(), method = "REML"),
    formula = y ~ s(x, k = 5),
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = binned,
    aes(x = quantity, y = prevalence, size = n),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ SEX_factor) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Logistic" = "#0072B2", "GAM" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    x = "Alcohol quantity",
    y = "CKD probability",
    colour = "Unadjusted model",
    size = "Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# m_int includes:
# alcohol_quantity * SEX_factor + AGE + drink-type indicators

# Remove only the interaction; retain all adjustment variables
m_no_int <- update(
  m_int,
  . ~ . - alcohol_quantity:SEX_factor
)

# Check both models use identical observations
stopifnot(identical(
  rownames(model.frame(m_no_int)),
  rownames(model.frame(m_int))
))

anova(m_no_int, m_int, test = "Chisq")
```
